LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION

                                   DOCKET NUMBER U-37882


                            ENTERGY LOUISIANA, LLC, EX PARTE


         In re: Application for certification ofgeneration and transmission resources
                                         andfor other relieﬁ



                   RULING ON MOTION FOR LEAVE TO FILE REPLY


              NOTICE OF       MODIFICATION               PROCEDURAL SCHEDULE


       On    July 15, 2026, the Alliance for Affordable Energy and the Union of Concerned

Scientists   (“NPOS”),     ﬁled with   the   Louisiana   Public   Service   Commission   (“LPSC”      or.




“Commission”) the Motion of the Alliance for Affordable Energy and Union of Concerned

Scientists for Access to    “Attorney ’s Eyes Only Information (“AEO Motion”)      seeking   access   to


certain information designated by Entergy Louisiana, LLC (“ELL”) as “Attorney’s Eyes Only”


(“AEO”). That same day, a deadline of July 17, 2026. was set for responses to the AEO Motion.

ELL and the Southern Renewable Energy Association ﬁled responses. On July 20, 2026., the NPOs


ﬁled a motion for leave to ﬁle a reply (“Motion for Leave”). Attached to the Motion for Leave was


the Reply in Support of the Alliance for Aﬂordable Energy and Union of Concerned Scientists’


Motion for Access to     “Attorney ’s Eyes Only” Information.

       HAVING CONSIDERED the Motion for Leave;


       IT IS HEREBY ORDERED that the Motion for Leave is granted.


       PLEASE TAKE NOTICE of the following modiﬁcations to the procedural schedule:


       Wednesday, July 29, 2026         .Oral Argument. Oral argument on the AEO Motion Will
